S.FORM: zyugi' mzyugi' sun na Tayal hya' ga, aring sa ini' uwah na' qu Gipun hga, nanak yaquw mnwah mgaga' squ ryax na magal ina' ga nanu' si kiy min'aring mtalah lga yasa qu mutuw mzyugi'. mnhhway qmara' sun maha zyugi' na Tayal balay hya' ga, nanu' qu sun maha mnhhway qmara' ka yasa siy s'rux ini' 'nrawmul iyal, ruw mnhawhway mkura' tay 'zil, ini' ga tay 'llaw mshzi'.
S.PHON: zjuɣiʔ mzjuɣiʔ [s|ɕ]un na tajal ħjaʔ ɣa ariŋ [s|ɕ]a iniʔ uwaħ naʔ qu ɣipun ħɣa nanak jaquw mnwaħ mɣaɣaʔ [s|ɕ]qu rjax na maɣal inaʔ ɣa nanuʔ [s|ɕ]i kij minʔariŋ mtalaħ lɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu mutuw mzjuɣiʔ mnħħwaj qmaraʔ [s|ɕ]un maħa zjuɣiʔ na tajal βalaj ħjaʔ ɣa nanuʔ qu [s|ɕ]un maħa mnħħwaj qmaraʔ ka ja[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]ij [s|ɕ]ʔrux iniʔ ʔnrawmul ijal ruw mnħawħwaj mkuraʔ taj ʔzil iniʔ ɣa taj ʔllaw m[s|ɕ]ħziʔ
